thread:
maya.cs: Quick FYI — ran a short perf sweep for the onboarding customer (NovaBank). p95 for chat generation is ~450ms and some tail spikes to ~900ms during peak. Renewal health is green but the account flagged latency in the onboarding call earlier. Thinking: try a short canary that does an int8 quantized swap + route heuristic for low-complexity calls. Thoughts?

liam.se: sounds reasonable. Do we have a compact candidate that preserves quality? I can try compact-7b-int8 (eval set shows ~2% quality drop on our prompts) — should save ~30-40% tokens/sec cost and lower latency.

anya.sre: +1 on canary. We need telemetry gating: set canary at 5% user traffic, monitor p50/p95, error rate, and model-quality regression (via our prompt-eval hooks). If p95 improves and q-regress <3% for 24h we can widen. Also add fallback to full model if latency >1s or if output fails safety checks.

devon_pm: From renewal perspective, latency is the main ask. If we can promise a measurable improvement before next check-in that helps retention. Schedule: can we run a 24h canary this week? Also capture customer-facing notes on expected changes (why outputs might slightly differ).

liam.se: I'll prepare the model artifact and a quick eval report. Plan: deploy compact-7b-int8 as model variant v2, route heuristics: if prompt token length < 150 AND request.metadata.purpose=="autocomplete" then route to v2. Otherwise default to v1. Example route rule: ```
route:
  - if: "tokens < 150 && metadata.purpose == 'autocomplete'"
    model: "compact-7b-int8-v2"
  - else: "full-13b-v1"
```

maya.cs: Nice. ops-bot — can you run a health check for their current request distribution and give a 72h baseline we can attach to the canary report? Also add a short note for CSM outreach so support team knows what to expect.

ops-bot: 72h baseline attached: avg qps=12, peak qps=38, median tokens=52, 95p latency=452ms. I also created ticket CS-4721 for outreach. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4721 :white_check_mark:

anya.sre: For the rollout infra: use a canary group with k8s deployment label canary=true, enable tracing (x-request-id), and set alert thresholds: p95 > 650ms (page), error rate +0.5% (warn). I can add the Prometheus alerts and Grafana panel.

devon_pm: Assign owners & timeline: Liam -> artifact + eval by EOD tomorrow. Anya -> canary infra + alerts by tomorrow EOD. Maya -> customer note + CS contact, send update to NovaBank PM. Ops-bot -> attach baseline and create the outreach ticket (done). After 24h with green metrics we expand to 25% for 48h then full.

maya.cs: I'll draft a short customer note: what changed, expected perf gains, fallback policy, and how to report issues. Will ping here before sending.

liam.se: Quick note on quant pitfalls: watch for tokenization edge cases and hallucination rate — include a small eval set with company-specific prompts. I'll drop the eval summary in the canary PR.

anya.sre: And add a short-run smoke test: 1000 requests at variable concurrency simulating peak — validate KV cache behaviour and latency tail.

maya.cs: Great. If no objections I'll kick this off after Liam uploads the artifact. Thanks team :rocket:
